In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of modern forensic science to leave clues that will aid her colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with the killer always one step ahead, Rachel must rely on her wits and cunning to stay alive.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel sets out to unravel the mystery of The Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But as they dig deeper, they realize that the killer's true intentions are far more sinister than they ever could have imagined.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack must work together to track down The Timekeeper before he strikes again. But with the clock ticking down, they know they have only 13 days to solve the case before The Timekeeper disappears into the timestream once more.

Will Rachel and Jack be able to catch The Timekeeper before it's too late, or will the killer's time-hopping abilities prove to be too much for them to handle? Dive into this thrilling tale of time travel, forensic science, and cat-and-mouse suspense to find out."
